info.name: DSA Recommendation Service
info.description: Online recommendation engine API: submission/state-update, recommendations, mastery/urgency reads, and CF/LC history seeding. This collection is a static snapshot for quick import -- for the always-current schema, import {{base_url}}/openapi.json directly into Postman instead (File > Import > Link).

item.name: Telemetry Scenarios
item.description: Six ready-to-send POST /update bodies, one per file in postman/telemetry_samples/, demonstrating each mastery-update mechanism (bounded delta, confidence penalty, wrong-answer cap, difficulty credit, trivial-solve dampening). See POSTMAN_GUIDE.md for expected results and run order.

request.description: verdict=WRONG_ANSWER: signal capped at <=0.35, no BKT learning-transition credit.
difficulty~0.5 -> neutral difficulty_credit (~1.0x), full capped delta.
Run this BEFORE 5b (same userId) to raise array mastery so 5b has something to be trivial relative to.

request.description: Run AFTER 5a. Same array topic, problemDifficulty=0.05 well below the now-higher mastery: smaller delta than Scenario 1 despite a perfect score -- this is bkt.py trivial-solve dampening. NOTE: this only shows the dampening effect if 5a ran first AND state persisted between calls (requires reachable Neo4j, or run postman/demo_progression.py instead -- see POSTMAN_GUIDE.md).

item.name: Full Pipeline (run_full_pipeline.py reference)
item.description: These are NOT HTTP requests -- run_full_pipeline.py is a standalone CLI script, not exposed over HTTP. This folder documents its request JSON shape (see postman/pipeline_requests/*.json) for reference. Run with: python run_full_pipeline.py --input-json postman/pipeline_requests/submission_then_recommend.json
